full_judgment:
These two Rules are directed against two orders of the learned District Judge in respect of two appeals arising out of two applications for pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. 

 2. On another application dated 13.7.66 of the petitioner for pre-empting another transfer dated 2.6.66 Misc. case No. 178 of 1966 was started. The learned Munsif by the judgment and order dated 12.9.70 rejected the pre-emptor's claim on the ground that the transfer was made by a Hebabil Ewaz and as such was not preempt able under section 96 (10) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. Against the aforesaid order, dated 12.9.70, the pre-emptor preferred Misc. appeal No. 57/72 on 2.8.72 along with a petition under section 5 of the Limitation Act before the learned District Judge who, however, rejected the prayer for condo nation of delay and dismissed the appeal on the ground of limitation. These two Rules are against the aforesaid two orders of the learned District Judge.
